get.description: Returns active setup catalog items for the selected customisation type. Use this for post-booking food, cake, decor, add-on and other options. Items are returned from the global active setup catalog, not restricted to package-included items.
Checks whether a custom start and end time is available for a branch and date. Times must be selected in 30-minute increments and within branch operating hours.

post.description: Creates a booking with custom start and end time. slot_start and slot_end must be 30-minute increments, within branch operating hours, and must not overlap another active booking.

post.summary: Update child pass guardian verification status
post.description: Marks the pass generated for a child as guardian verified.

patch.description: Updates a booking with custom start and end time. slot_start and slot_end must be 30-minute increments, within branch operating hours, and must not overlap another active booking.

post.description: Adds a post-booking food, cake, decor or add-on item and returns the recalculated booking breakdown.

patch.description: Updates a post-booking customisation item and returns the recalculated booking breakdown.

delete.description: Removes a manually added post-booking customisation and returns the recalculated booking breakdown. Package-included customisations cannot be removed.

post.description: Adds a guest contact for a booking. Each guest can carry adult and child counts for that specific person/family entry.

patch.description: Updates a guest contact and the adult/child counts for that guest entry.

post.summary: Create Razorpay order for booking payment
post.description: Creates or reuses a pending Razorpay order for the booking balance due. Android should use the returned checkout payload to open Razorpay Checkout.

post.summary: Verify Razorpay payment and confirm booking
post.description: Verifies the Razorpay signature returned by Android Checkout. On success, records payment, marks the booking confirmed, updates amount_paid, and clears balance_due for a full payment.
